headline: Capital Small Finance Bank targets Rs 16,000 crore AUM by FY29
hook: Aggressive growth target for Capital SFB
summary: Capital Small Finance Bank plans to expand its assets under management to Rs 16,000 crore by the end of fiscal year 2029. Executive Director Munish Jain stated the bank will maintain its retail-focused lending model while aiming to reduce net non-performing assets to below 1%. The bank intends to expand its operations beyond its traditional base in Punjab to achieve these growth targets. This strategy signals a shift toward broader geographic reach and improved asset quality for the small finance lender.
why_it_matters: Bank's expansion and asset quality goals influence long-term stock performance.
winners_losers: Capital SFB shareholders gain / competitors face pressure

headline: Capital Small Finance, Coal India, and Indegene report Q2 profit growth
hook: Strong quarterly earnings across diverse sectors
summary: Capital Small Finance Bank reported a 31% increase in profit for the second quarter. Coal India saw a significant 53% jump in its quarterly earnings. Indegene also posted a 10% surge in profit. These results reflect varying performance trends across the banking, energy, and healthcare services sectors.
why_it_matters: Positive earnings may drive short-term stock price appreciation for these firms.
winners_losers: Coal India, Indegene, Capital SFB gain

headline: Capital Small Finance Bank holds committee meeting
hook: Leadership and compensation review at Capital SFB
summary: Capital Small Finance Bank's Nomination and Remuneration Committee met on October 28, 2026. The meeting focused on internal governance, specifically regarding nomination and remuneration matters. No specific personnel changes or compensation figures were disclosed in the initial filing.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no immediate impact on share price.
